name: Kaizoku
description: Automated manga downloader built on Suwayomi that keeps a library in sync with new chapters.

envVars.description: URL of the Suwayomi/Tachidesk backend it downloads through

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      TACHIDESK_BASE_URL: {{env.TACHIDESK_BASE_URL}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/config:/config
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/data
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-redis
  {{serviceName}}-redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
